paite: Huan Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon kiang ah asikhate asawl hi; apa mun ah kumpipa in amah thau anilh uh chih lah ana zata ngal a. Hiram in David a-it gige him ahi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding In Solomon Akisakhol / (2 Kro 2.1-18)

paite: Solomon in mi sawl in Hiram kiang ah,
"Ka pa David in TOUPA'N akhepek nuai a akoih masiah akimvel a mun chih mual chih a kidounate ziak a TOUPA a Pathian min a dia inn alam theihlouhdan na thei hi.
Tu in TOUPA ka Pathian in mun chih mual chih ah muanna ahon neisakta hi. Melma leh vangsiatna leng a-om kei hi.

Ngai dih, TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na tapa na sik a na laltutphah ka luahsak ding in ka min a ding in inn ahon lam ding, chi a ana gensa bang in, TOUPA ka Pathian min a ding in inn lam ka tum hi.'

Huaiziak in tu in Lebanon tang a sidar singte hon phuksak ding in thu pia inla, ka sikhate leng na sikhate lak ah ahong tel sam ding ua, na sikhate loh ahihleh na chih peuhmah ka hon pe ding. Zidon mite bang a sing phuksiam ka lak uah kuamah a-om kei uh, chih lah na thei ngal a," chi in agensak hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hiram in Solomon thu azak in akipak mahmah hi. "Hiai mi tampi tung a vaihawm dia tapa piltak David pepa TOUPA tuni in phat in om hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Hiram in Solomon kiang ah, "N'on thukhah ka na za hi. Sidar sing thu leh meilah sing thu na deih peuhmah ka hih ding.

Ka sikhate'n Lebanon tang a pan tuipi pha in ahon lasuk ding ua, n'on mun sehsak a tuipi a tolh ding in ka gaklopsak ding hi. Huai ah ka phelsak dia, nang na na la ding hi. Nang leng ka inkote nek ding tum in ka deih na hon hihsak sam ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Hiram in sidar sing leh meilah sing Solomon deih teng apia hi.
Solomon in Hiram inkote nek ding in buh pota singnih leh sathau suk pota sawmnih apia hi. Hiai Solomon in kum teng a Hiram apiakdan ahi.
TOUPA'N achiam bangtak in Solomon pilna apia hi. Hiram leh Solomon kikal ah kilemna a-om a; anih un kilemna thukhun abawl uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in Israel tengteng lak ah phutluih nasemmi abawl a; amau mi singthum ahi uh.
Lebanon ah kha khat a kikheng zel in singkhat asawl zel hi. Kha khat Lebanon ah a-om ua, kha nih amau inn ah. Phutluih nasem mite heutu Adoniram ahi.
Solomon in tangte ah thil pomi singsagih leh suangsekmi singgiat anei hi.
Huaite sim louh in Solomon in anasep tung a heutu tuam, nasep vengmi sangthum-le-zathum anei lai hi.
Kumpipa thupiak in inn suangphum dia lep ding in suang lian pipi, suang mantam pipi leh suang seksa ahon pua uhi.
Inn lam mite, Solomon mite leh Hiram mite leh Gebal mite'n suangte asek ua, huai inn lamna ding in sing leh suangte abawl uhi.
